title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy
description: Five students of the Rescue Bots Training Academy from Cybertron—Hot Shot, Whirl, Medix, Hoist and Wedge—learn to respond to emergency situations and become heroes.

episodes.title: S2-E4Medix Steps Up to the Bat

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: Hoist builds a cleaning droid to help scrub the academy, but instead it nearly destroys it.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 30

episodes_data.description: When Hot Shot replaces Chase's traffic stop simulation for his computer game—the recruits find themselves unprepared as they face giant hedgehogs.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: When the other Recruits tell Medix he's a 'stick in the mud,' he enlists Chase to help him learn how to loosen up. But Medix's newfound sense of humor threatens a rescue and his value to the team.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: Hoist is terrified by the Academy's new teacher, Grimlock... Until some intervention from his friends and Heatwave shows him everyone gets scared of something, but courage is proceeding anyway.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 36
episodes_data.description: Alone in the Academy with a Triceratops, Hoist must overcome his fear of dinosaurs and calm the savage beast.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 37
episodes_data.description: When the recruits take part in a training exercise for covert policing, Hot Shot is partnered with the least stealthy of all Rescue Bots, Grimlock.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 38
episodes_data.description: When the team are sent to evacuate a colony of rare Yellow-Eyed penguins from an island, the approaching electrical storm affects the Trainees abilities and they discover the only tool they have left is their brains.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 39
episodes_data.description: Hoist uses an unfair advantage to win a search game, allowing him to choose the location for the next Sim Exercise. He picks the Old West, and as the Recruits search for gold, Hoist learns that winning isn't everything.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 40
episodes_data.description: Whilst looking for some crashed pieces of a space satellite, Wedge pulls off a spectacular rescue at Dig Fest and becomes an unlikely star of the show.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 41
Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 42
episodes_data.description: Medix mistakes TV commercial for a real monster attack in Milford and sets off to save the city.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 43
Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 44
episodes_data.description: On a field trip to an area of natural beauty the Recruits face a swarm of metalmunching Scraplets.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 45
episodes_data.description: Wedge is excited when his hero Bumblebee visits the academy as a guest teacher, but the young bot's attempts to impress backfire.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 46
episodes_data.description: When Whirl struggles with a tricky maneuver, she doubts her place on the team. Reassuring her, Blades mentions a distant Rescue Bot Guru who once helped him.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 47
episodes_data.description: When the Bots go on a satellite repair mission, their carelessly discarded trash hurtles around the earth's orbit, growing into a problem big enough to destroy them and the Sigma.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 48
episodes_data.description: The Recruits travel deep underwater to find an unmanned submersible. But a struggle to communicate effectively in the deep, dark waters nearly scuppers the mission.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 49
episodes_data.description: When the dogs start behaving strangely near the Academy, Hoist sees the investigation as an opportunity to try out his new communications system, but it's the comms that are the problem.

Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 51
Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy Season 1 Episode 52
episodes_data.description: There's no 'I' in team.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x1
episodes_data.description: It's back to school for Year Two - but the recruits find the teachers are planning to spin things up a gear. Things are about to get tough!

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x2
Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x3
episodes_data.description: When Hot Shot is given chores to do by Heatwave rather than what he considers real training, he is stunned to find that everything is a learning experience and Heatwave is a great teacher.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x4
episodes_data.description: When Medix brings a bat with him to Cybertron, chaos ensues. And as Hot Shot gets blamed for it all, Medix has to accept that a high tech environment probably isn't the best place for a wild creature!

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x5
episodes_data.description: When the Bots mistakenly think Cody wants to be physically like them, they build him a robo-suit that causes serious metal mayhem.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x6
episodes_data.description: Medix is sure he has a list for every possible emergency ever. So, to teach him the value of improvising in the moment, his mentor, Blades, has him look after a very unpredictable dog...

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x7
episodes_data.description: The recruits latest mission is to star in the Griffin Rock 'Play in the Park'. The recruits are delighted, except for Wedge who believes that it's a waste of time as it's not rescue work.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x8
episodes_data.description: When Hoist and Bumblebee go on a rescue mission to save families of rock creatures from a meteor shower they need help from Cybertron, in the form of Perceptor.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x9
episodes_data.description: When Hot Shot borrows Grimlock's cube without asking, things rapidly get out of hand and the only one who can help is Grimlock himself.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x10
episodes_data.description: As a treat for doing well in training the bots are allowed to choose their favorite simulated rescue, but when they can't decide whose rescue is best they break the sym.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x11
episodes_data.description: When Hoist goes prospecting in the hope of striking energon, he finds that rickety old mines are not built for bots, especially big scary dinobots.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x12
episodes_data.description: Ratchet invites the recruits to help open an ancient Cybertronian Vault. However, the vault won't give up its secrets that easily and challenges the recruits to complete an ancient sym mission to prove that they are worthy of its treasures. And oh, what treasures they are!

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x13
episodes_data.description: For her first detective mission of year two, Whirl is tasked with investigating the paranormal with her skeptical new partner, Medix.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x14
episodes_data.description: Upon discovering the Galax plant from planet Parvus is still being housed in the academy's quarantine Medix sets about finding the plant a new home.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x15
episodes_data.description: When Chase takes Whirl on a mission to guard an exhibit at Griffin Rock’s newest museum, a major theft convinces Chase that the former criminals, and long-time Rescue Bots foes, Evan and Myles, are back in action.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x16
episodes_data.description: The entire Academy face an epic mission to rescue Cody's best friend, Frankie, who's trapped inside a seemingly impenetrable dome that's shrinking by the minute.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x17
episodes_data.description: Even though Medix is just trying to help his fellow Rescue Bot recruits train in new rescue techniques, the others find Medix to be overly harsh and critical.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x18
episodes_data.description: The recruits visit a funfair run by a team of rule-loving Fun-Droids, but when the droids malfunction it's not just the rules that get broken.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x19
episodes_data.description: Each recruit receives a new tool that their individual spark picks for them. However, Hot Shot is not happy with his and convinces Wedge to swap. However, they soon discover that their 'spark' knows best.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x20
episodes_data.description: Cody surprises the bots by making them do ballet lessons as part of their training, something which Medix finds particularly difficult to embrace.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x21
episodes_data.description: When Hot Shot is told his Mul-T-Cog can be used to Mul-T-Change, he has to learn that the key to making that happen isn't all about himself.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x22
episodes_data.description: Whirl's power of observations are tested when the rescue bots disappear one by one on a training exercise.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x23
episodes_data.description: After a smug string of handing out sage advice to his fellow Bots, Medix is now faced with the dilemma of having to listen to his own 'simple' words of wisdom.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x24
episodes_data.description: Cody takes the recruits on a camping trip. When he tells them a spooky campfire tale, Hot Shot gets spooked. When they return to the Academy Hot Shot hears strange sounds and comes to the conclusion that the 'Zombie Ghost Bear' has followed them back.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x25
episodes_data.description: The recruits are all excited about getting their new Mul-T-Cogs - a little too excited, as Hot Shot convinces them to take them before they're ready.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x26
episodes_data.description: As the recruits face some big decisions about their new Mul-T-Cog vehicle forms, Hot Shot must decide what's really important to his rescue work.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x27
episodes_data.description: When the recruits respond to an intergalactic distress signal they discover Scorch and his friends under attack from an abandoned city. But Scorch didn't send the signal. So who is in distress.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x28
episodes_data.description: Wedge is faced with a tough decision after mentor training day, while Wes is about to take his Griffin Rock First Responder exam.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x29
episodes_data.description: Medix's patience is put to the test when the recruits are given the task of training five metal-munching Scraplets.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x30
episodes_data.description: Whirl feels Medix is getting preferential treatment in helicopter mode but her insecurity risks both their safety during a rescue.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x31
episodes_data.description: Whirl has gotten so used to being part of a team, that she doesn't like to make decisions without them, even though she is perfectly capable of doing so.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x32
episodes_data.description: Whirl has to rescue a powered down Scorch - and as he refuses to fly, spend all day towing him back to the Academy.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x33
Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x34
episodes_data.description: A run away train on Griffin Rock forces Wedge to reflect on his new vehicle form, while Heatwave, Hot Shot and Whirl endure the comedic stylings of Mayor Luskey.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x35
episodes_data.description: When the Recruits rescue a Decepticon from a damaged ship, they disagree on how to treat the 'evil' bot, forcing Wedge to reveal his biggest secret.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x36
episodes_data.description: When things mysteriously start to get damaged around the Academy, Hoist investigates. But when the evidence points to a dinobot culprit, the whole case becomes much more personal.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x37
episodes_data.description: Medix is sure Perceptor will be thrilled to have him as a student. So when the science professor seems more interested in the other recruits, Medix determines to get himself noticed…

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x38
episodes_data.description: When some human teenagers become famous rescue heroes the Rescue Bot recruits must deal with their jealousy.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x39
Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x40
Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x41
Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x42
Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x43
episodes_data.description: When the Rescue Bots and recruits are all away from the Academy, Sludge and Snarl are put in charge.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x44
episodes_data.description: When Wedge tires of his friends constantly interrupting him, he volunteers for a solo mission on a Titan.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x45
episodes_data.description: The Bots travel to Ireland to follow a Cybertronian treasure trail, or so they think.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x46
episodes_data.description: When Wedge needs a speed coach, Bumblebee thinks Hot Shot will be the perfect choice. But Hot Shot soon learns that teaching can be as tricky as learning.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x47
episodes_data.description: A mission gives the recruits a chance to test out their new homemade sirens, but some alien creatures don't react well to loud noise.

Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x49
Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x50

Transformers: Rescue Bots Academy 2x52
episodes_data.description: It's the final test to graduate Year Two and the recruits are nervous. Though Hot Shot's got something else on his mind—making sure his teachers know just how much he appreciates them.
